messages:
sam: Heads up — canary (route: /v1/generate, model: mistral-7b-gqa) is showing steady KV memory growth after the batching heuristic tweak. Started after the change that prefers micro-batches for latency.
kevin: repro steps? spike on long-context convs or short requests?
sam: long multi-turn convs (avg 6 turns, ~6k tokens). Memory climbs ~200MB per minute until it hits dedicated pool OOM threshold. Eviction counters stay near-zero.
tess: that sounds like fragmentation + reuse miss. Do we have a profile snapshot?
sam: pasted a mini profile from the canary (redacted):
```
profile@1782009876: kernel_selector -> kernel_v1 (small_seq) then kernel_v2 (kv_paged)
kv_slots_allocated: 432MB -> 1.18GB over 22min
kv_fragmentation_ratio: 0.68 -> 0.83
eviction_ops: 4
page_out_ops: 0
reuse_hits: 12 (expected ~120)
rope_scale_factor: 1.000 (requests: mixture of qwen/llama tokens)
```
kevin: interesting — kernel_selector flipping to kv_paged seems to not actually page; page_out_ops=0 indicates paging path not exercised.
maria: could be MQA vs GQA mismatch: if key canonicalization differs we get reuse misses and create new KV entries that don't compaction-match.
tess: which models exactly? sam mentioned mistral-7b-gqa. Any llama/mqa repros?
sam: yes — separate run on llama-65b-mqa shows similar growth but different signal: rope exponent scaling applied at decode time makes KV keys differ between earlier prefix saves and later reuse attempts. reuse_hits are near zero.
kevin: so two separate but related problems: (1) fragmentation + no real paging (paging codepath not triggered despite kernel hint), (2) key mismatch across rope/MQA/GQA leading to cache duplication.
tess: propose quick mitigation: (A) force eviction when fragmentation_ratio > 0.75 (override kernel hint), (B) add canonicalization step for KV keys that normalizes rope scaling and MQA gating bits before lookup.
maria: agree. also add a canary integration test that runs mixed-model multi-turn flows with synthetic rope scaling patterns.
sam: I can push a patch toggling the eviction threshold to 0.75 and wire a metric to track page_out_ops vs evictions.
kevin: add a flag so we can rollback to previous heuristic remotely. Also add a small perf test to ensure latency impact < 5%.
tess: I'll take the key canonicalization change — plan:
- detect model family (llama/mistral/qwen)
- normalize rope exponent into a canonical bucket (e.g., round to 1e-3)
- mask out MQA internal gating bits before hash
should be a small change in kv_lookup pipeline.
maria: can you add unit tests that simulate rope mismatch? probably mock decode with scaled sinusoid keys.
perf-bot: deploy scheduled: canary patch v0.9.3 -> eng-runtime-canary @1782012000 :hammer_and_wrench:
sam: rolled v0.9.3 to canary at 1782012000. Watching metrics.
kevin: thanks — if we still see no page_outs but high fragmentation, we should instrument why the paging code chooses not to run (locks? threshold?).
maria: noted — I'll add an assert in paging toggles and run a stress harness overnight.
tess: I pushed a draft PR for key canonicalization, assigning to @maria for tests.
sam: current canary: kv_slots_allocated flattened after patch, reuse_hits up ~3x in short window. Not full fix but promising.
kevin: good. schedule follow-up tomorrow at 10am to validate and decide whether to roll to Dedicated.
maria: added integration job: runtime/kv-multi-model-smoke -> will run against canary tonight.
perf-bot: job runtime/kv-multi-model-smoke completed @1782013400 :white_check_mark:
sam: results look goodish — fragmentation reduced to 0.58 and reuse_hits doubled. leaving this thread open until we have full regression run.
kevin: thx everyone. please post final postmortem + changelog entries once we've rolled.
